question: Does the archived0% goal classifier validly support the old no-leakage interpretation, and can these caches identify leakage beyond selected actions?

verified_error.operation: Original leave-one-row-out retains the same-rep opposite-label mate in training. Reanalysis holds out both labels for the same planner RNG seed.
verified_error.analytic_explanation: When both labels have identical x_i for each of n repetition pairs and m is their mean, row-LOO yields own-class center (n*m-x_i)/(n-1) and opposite-class center m. For x_i != m, distance to the own-class center is n/(n-1) times larger. All such held-out rows are mechanically assigned the wrong label; this is neither a reverse privacy signal nor a valid no-information accuracy estimate.
verified_error.executable_witness: The reanalysis script includes two identical-feature pairs with row-LOO0% and paired-CV50% under the fixed lowest-label tie rule. No model or environment is involved.

verified_reanalysis.scaling: Original raw-scale nearest centroids; no tuning, feature rescaling or representation selection.
verified_reanalysis.precision_limit: Some geometry pairs differ at floating-point scale. Report exact equality counts individually; chance accuracy does not prove all cached features or unsaved full transcripts identical.
verified_reanalysis.inference_limit: Classifier accuracy differences are descriptive, not conditional mutual information or a conditional-independence test. No p-values or significance claims.

native_system_correction.v0: The checkpoint dynamics are native; the planner and random latent-goal objective are researcher-added. No selected action was executed in the environment.
native_system_correction.v1_and_geometry: The planner averages reward-head logits instead of native two-hot decoding; its public/base_returns accumulator is outside the CEM iteration loop, adding scores across unrelated candidate populations. No native terminal-Q estimate is used. Thus the saved queries cannot stand in for a corrected native controller.
native_system_correction.historical_code: All original run files and generation scripts remain unchanged. This reanalysis fixes statistical interpretation; it does not regenerate or repair their model computations.

privacy_criterion_calibration.exact_action_equality: A sufficient matched privacy contrast, not necessary for every privacy claim. Incremental leakage conditional on observables or pre-action leakage may be legitimate separate estimands.
privacy_criterion_calibration.available_cache_limit: Only query moment/quantile summaries and selected first actions are saved. Full1920-query transcripts and timestamps are unavailable. Each dataset contains one fixed environment root and one development-selected goal pair, with12 or16 planner seed groups.
privacy_criterion_calibration.decision: Do not infer either verified native private-task leakage or universal absence of query leakage. A new study would need a competent native private-goal interface, predeclared observable information/timing, held-out goals/states, and matched controls. The statistics correction alone does not reopen a GPU panel.

independent_review: A second agent read the new grouping code and recorded results: every group excludes both seed mates; all six datasets reproduce the old query metric; source scoring defects and cache limits are accurately stated. No duplicate model/statistical execution was requested.

api_review.root_adjudication: Advisory screening only, not proof that no future candidate exists. General statements about all carriers or non-native hooks are not adopted as universal exclusions. Explicit assumed supply-chain interfaces remain legitimate when precisely scoped. The statistical correction above is independently established from saved data and code, not derived from the API opinion.
